text: Smart mailbox URIs use the canonical folderTypes names, while actual folder names may be translated. Accepted lookup therefore uses getChildWithURI rather than a child-name lookup. Keep the canonical type name, localized name and stored URI distinct when adding a unified folder. This is the smart-mailbox boundary, not a rule that all folders have untranslated names. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Look up unified folders through canonical URIs when names are localized
